subject: The Perfect Burnout Game
author: ZombieTron
body:
Dunno about the whole off road idea, I never got into FUEL (not sure I ever even played it as I didn't really like the look of it).

Burnout should be about driving dangerously to earn boost and racing around the coolest tracks ever designed! 😃 Anything on top of that is fine, as long as it doesn't detract from the essence of Burnout!
